questions.stem: Before servicing a machine that could start automatically, the most important step is to:
options: Run it for an hour first
Isolate it and lock out the power so it cannot start
questions.explanation: Lockout and tag-out protects you from accidental start-up.

questions.stem: WHMIS helps engine-room workers by providing:
options: Labels and safety data sheets for hazardous products
questions.explanation: WHMIS is hazard communication for workplace chemicals.

questions.stem: Which set lists the three basic workers' rights under occupational health and safety law in Canada?
options: Right to overtime, right to a pension, right to strike
Right to a cabin, right to leave, right to a bonus
Right to know, right to participate, right to refuse unsafe work
Right to inspect, right to fine, right to hire
questions.explanation: Know, participate, refuse. Check provincial and federal wording with an examiner.

questions.stem: Before entering a confined space such as a tank, you must at minimum:
options: Hold your breath and enter quickly
Test the atmosphere and make sure it is safe and ventilated, with a standby person
Enter if the hatch has been open for a minute
Send in a lit torch to check for gas
questions.explanation: Oxygen deficiency and toxic or flammable gas kill quickly. Test, ventilate, control entry.

questions.stem: Hot work (welding, grinding, cutting) aboard should only start after:
options: The engine has been running for 10 minutes
Surrounding hazards are cleared and a fire watch and extinguisher are in place
questions.explanation: Remove combustibles, check adjoining spaces, and keep a fire watch.

questions.stem: A safety data sheet (SDS) for a cleaning solvent tells you:
options: The hazards, protective equipment, first aid, fire and spill advice for the product
The tide times at the dock
The fuel burn of the engine
questions.explanation: The SDS is the full hazard information for a product under WHMIS. The label gives the short summary, and the SDS gives the detail.

questions.stem: Which PPE protects against the noise of running engines?
questions.explanation: Hearing protection is worn in noisy machinery spaces. Prolonged noise damages hearing without pain, so it is easy to ignore.

questions.stem: Why should you avoid loose clothing, jewellery and dangling lanyards near an engine room?
options: They can catch on rotating shafts and belts and pull you in
questions.explanation: Rotating shafts, couplings and belts can wrap around loose items instantly. Wear close-fitting clothes and tie back hair.

questions.stem: After locking out and tagging a machine, the final step before you start work is to:
options: Try the start control to prove it cannot start
questions.explanation: Testing proves the isolation worked. Lockout is: tell, isolate, lock and tag, release stored energy, test, then work.

questions.stem: A crew member collapses inside a tank. The best first action is to:
options: Wait for them to wake up
Raise the alarm and rescue only with breathing apparatus and a plan
questions.explanation: A poor atmosphere kills would-be rescuers quickly. Call for help, keep the standby outside and use breathing apparatus and a rescue plan.

questions.stem: Electrical equipment must be treated as live until it has been:
questions.explanation: Switching off at one point is not proof. Isolate, lock, and test with a proper instrument before touching.

questions.stem: Before hot work on a bulkhead, you should clear combustibles, have an extinguisher ready and:
options: Post a fire watch and check the other side of the bulkhead
questions.explanation: Heat travels through steel and can ignite material on the other side. A fire watch stays during and after the work.

questions.stem: You hurt your hand on a sharp edge but it is minor. The most appropriate thing to do is:
options: Ignore it because it is minor
Report it and get it treated, and report the hazard
Wait for it to get worse
questions.explanation: Report every injury, near miss and hazard. It fixes the cause and protects the next person, and it is required by the company's procedures.
